name: real_normal_adapt_v2_dev
purpose: Development stage for target-normal adaptation of M0/ENS to causal Real. Find whether Real-normal-only information can remove the saturated false alarms seen in real_event_eval_v1, before any further Real test access.

allowed_data.fit: Real adapt_normal (10 cases, 598 supervised windows; full-timeline frames allowed)
allowed_data.check: Real calibrate_normal (5 cases, 301 windows; full-timeline frames allowed)
allowed_data.source: train/val as before; val used to check source fault recall is unchanged for arms that alter the models

forbidden: Real test_normal, test_fault, supplemental_normal_test in this stage

candidate_arms.D1_affine: per-channel affine input alignment fit on adapt_normal input-valid frames: x' = (x - mu_R) / sd_R * sd_S + mu_S, with mu_S/sd_S from train independent-normal (normal_flight) input-valid frames; channel 25 (acc_norm) recomputed from aligned accel; applied to Real only, before both models
candidate_arms.D2_gbt_target_normal: GBT refit with frozen recipe plus adapt_normal windows (all valid frame-ends stride 5) labelled normal, total weight equal to 0.1 of source normal weight; M0 unchanged; ENS = mean

dev_metrics: window FPR at 0.5 and frame-level fraction >= ENS/M0 chosen onsets on calibrate_normal; event replay (same policy, onsets 0.70 M0 / 0.75 ENS) on calibrate_normal full timelines; adapt numbers reported as in-sample; val window fault recall and normal FPR for D2
decision: No pass/fail in dev. Arms that do not bring calibrate_normal window FPR below 20% are dropped. Any arm kept must be frozen in a separate v2 test protocol before Real test access, and that test is labelled exploratory because Real was already viewed.
